]

from hamana import Query
from hamana.core.column import IntegerColumn, StringColumn, DateColumn

columns = [
    IntegerColumn(name="id", order=1),
    StringColumn(name="name", order=2),
    DateColumn(name="created_at", order=3),
]

query = Query(
    query="SELECT id, name, created_at FROM users",
    columns=columns
)

print(f"Query: {query.query}")
print(f"Columns: {[(col.name, col.dtype.value) for col in query.columns]}")
